summary: Helsinki, Finland, software developer, B.Sc. in Computer Systems, strong interest in Linux and open-source software, particularly elementary OS and KDE, avid user of programming languages like Java and Python, enjoys fishing and outdoor activities, critical of corporate practices and privacy issues, advocates for free software and ethical tech, has children, experiences with ADHD, values education and self-improvement, engaged in discussions about political and social issues, particularly around censorship and freedom of speech.
